entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: An orphaned young Nezumi artificer from Kamigawa, adopted by Tamiyo and Genku, who takes up his mother's storytelling mantle.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker and story collector who adopted Nashi, was compleated and died during the invasion; only a story echo remains.

entities.name: Genku
entities.description: Tamiyo's husband and Nashi's adoptive father.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker whose Infinite Consortium burned Nashi's village, later left braindead, and who spared Nashi during the invasion.

entities.name: Baltrice
entities.description: Tezzeret's second-in-command who burned down Nashi's village.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker who tracked Tezzeret and later helped Nashi escape Duskmourn.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker who visited Nashi's family and sympathized over his loss of Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Obeka
entities.description: Enforcer of the Slickshot Gang who fought Nashi on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Slickshot Gang
entities.description: A criminal gang on Thunder Junction that concocted a magic-amplifying elixir.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A figure who felled Tamiyo and later helped rescue Nashi in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A character who helped free Nashi in Duskmourn.

entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A character who betrayed Nashi's party to the Cult of Valgavoth.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A demon who feeds on stolen stories to place doors beyond Duskmourn.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: A cult dedicated to Valgavoth that captured Nashi's party.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: A wounded Survivor who agreed to join the cultists.

entities.name: Sunset
entities.description: An uninjured Survivor captive of the cult.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who tasked Tamiyo with compleating Kamigawa.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective who helped create an artificial Omenpath.

entities.name: Reckoners
entities.description: Nashi's Nezumi gang.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Nashi's home plane.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where Nashi was trapped for three months.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane where Nashi began collecting stories and stole an elixir.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Nashi lost his mother.

events.summary: Tezzeret's Infinite Consortium comes to Kamigawa; Baltrice burns Nashi's village, killing his parents and scarring him.
events.quote: Nashi's parents died in the process and he was left heavily scarred by a fire elemental controlled by Baltrice.

events.summary: Tezzeret is betrayed by his subordinates and left braindead in the burned village.
events.quote: Tezzeret was betrayed by his subordinates , who left him braindead in the burned village for the ratfolk to do with as they wished.
This changed when Tamiyo came to him and insisted he call her nothing but Tamiyo.

events.summary: Kaito Shizuki tries to track Nashi for information about Tezzeret, but Tamiyo intercepts him.
events.quote: Tamiyo intercepted him and appealed to leave her son due to his trauma.

events.summary: Tezzeret captures Tamiyo, who is compleated; Nashi vows to find his mother.
events.quote: The young nezumi vowed to find his mother

events.summary: Nashi attacks Tezzeret demanding his mother; Tezzeret subdues him, kills his gang and lets him live.
events.quote: The planeswalker easily subdued him and killed the other nezumi in his gang.

events.summary: Nashi tries to reason with the compleated Tamiyo, who is felled by the Wanderer; her past self's projection comforts him.
events.quote: She refused and was felled by the Wanderer .

events.summary: After the invasion Nashi returns to Genku and takes up his mother's story circle.
events.quote: Nashi later took up his mother's story circle, collecting new stories in her stead.

events.summary: On Thunder Junction Nashi breaks into the Slickshot Gang's headquarters, is stopped by Obeka, then succeeds by channeling story magic through video footage and steals the elixir.
events.quote: He was much more proficient with this method and successfully stole the elixir.

events.summary: Nashi follows Tamiyo's voice to a door to Duskmourn and travels through with six friends, trapped for three months.
events.quote: he took six of his closest friends, other nezumi Reckoners, and traveled through, where he was trapped for three months.

events.summary: The Wanderer, Niko Aris and Winter find Nashi imprisoned with friends, four already turned to wickerfolk, and free him and two friends.
events.quote: Niko and the Wanderer used shards and fire to drive off the creatures and free Nashi and his two remaining friends.

events.summary: Winter betrays the party to the Cult of Valgavoth, which captures Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi and kills or turns his last friends.
events.quote: Niko, the Wanderer, and Nashi were captured after a betrayal by Winter, who sealed them in the room with the cultists.

events.summary: The Wanderer realizes the cult is siphoning Tamiyo's story echo to feed Valgavoth.
events.quote: the cult was using Tamiyo's scroll echo to siphon her stories and feed them to the demon Valgavoth

events.summary: Nashi learns Tamiyo's echo cannot leave Duskmourn, accepts her passing and destroys the ghost trap, then escapes via an artificial Omenpath by Kaito and Proft.
events.quote: He decided to accept her passing, destroying the ghost trap so that the cultists wouldn't be able to exploit her anymore.

relations.quote: He was adopted by the planeswalker Tamiyo and her husband Genku
Tezzeret sent his second-in-command Baltrice to assassinate the village's chief
a betrayal by Winter, who sealed them in the room with the cultists

relations.note: A cult dedicated to the demon.
relations.quote: a dangerous group dedicated to the demon Valgavoth
